dogecoin.text: $DOGE looking like it will retest the 55 sat support. Not a lot of volume and no buy wall so may fall through. However history shows it is quite a strong support line. Was rejected on the past 4h candle. Bounce could see it head to 78 sats

As someone that was buying $DOGE under half a cent and sold around 6-8c, I'm a lot more pissed about that then I am for not owning any $SHIB

Chances are if you had SHIB early this year, you would've sold waaayyyy before it went +8t%. Don't beat yourself up about it
